title: Moore photographs documents in an upstate New York hotel room

tellings.quote: He had to go one time he was told in the middle of this he said go to this hotel room in upstate New York.

plain: In the early 1980s, a man named Bill Moore was told to go to a hotel room in upstate New York, where he photographed documents left for him there. Greg Bishop tells Michels this, passing on what Moore himself said about how he was summoned "in the middle of" his dealings with his contacts. If true, it would mean someone was deliberately putting papers into Moore's hands.
